description.description: Description is the plugin description from the OCI config labels.

files.description: Files is the list of all files in the artifact with their sizes.

path.description: Path is the file path within the artifact.

size.description: Size is the uncompressed file size in bytes.

license.description: License is the SPDX license identifier from the OCI config labels.

name.description: Name is the plugin name from the OCI config labels.

version.description: Version is the plugin version from the OCI config labels.

404.description: Not Found (artifact not present in registry)

502.description: Bad Gateway (upstream registry or git resolver failure)
